title: Gran Turismo 7 review: An excellent racing game buried in dull exposition
quote: Gran Turismo 7 feels like someone letting you drive their incredibly expensive supercar, but only if you drive under 30 miles per hour and stay on suburban streets.

title: Review: Bayonetta 3 is a love letter to gaming’s most wildly creative action star | VGC
quote: While some ideas get lost in Bayonetta 3’s endless sprint to keep you entertained, there’s no other action game with this imagination, wit or style. Prepare to explore its mad depths for weeks.

title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land Review (Switch) | Nintendo Life
quote: We've already discussed in our hands-on preview of the game's first world how Kirby and the Forgotten Land eschews the wide open 3D environments of Super Mario Odyssey in favour of tightly designed little playboxes in the vein of Super Mario 3D World.

title: Pokémon Scarlet and Violet Review (Switch) | Nintendo Life
quote: And if anything has come close to recapturing the real magic we felt when we discovered our first Pokémon world in Red & Blue, it’s Pokémon Scarlet & Violet's vast and open Paldea region.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Review (Switch) | Nintendo Life
quote: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 delivers all of this and so much more in a game that ramps up the emotional intensity, gives us the best combat the franchise has seen to date and introduces an all-new cast of characters that we'll genuinely never forget.
